reasons.startup: Read-only because Pilot owns this server-level startup setting.
reasons.memory: Read-only because an unsafe value can exhaust memory shared by MariaDB and the bench.
reasons.buffer_pool: Managed automatically with InnoDB Buffer Pool size so Pilot can enforce the host memory budget.
reasons.workload: Read-only because an unsafe global value can interrupt Frappe requests, jobs, or migrations.
reasons.replication: Read-only because changing binary logging or replication settings can affect recovery data.
reasons.recovery: Read-only because this is a recovery control that should only be used during incident response.
reasons.security: Read-only because Pilot keeps this security-sensitive setting at a safe server default.
reasons.performance_schema: Use the Performance Schema Quick action so Pilot can restart and verify MariaDB safely.
reasons.innodb_status_output_locks: Read-only because enabling verbose lock output can produce substantial diagnostic logs.
reasons.long_query_time: Read-only because MariaDB 11.8 uses version-specific slow-query controls.

variables.name: connect_timeout
variables.label: Connection handshake timeout
variables.description: Seconds MariaDB waits for a client to finish its initial handshake.

variables.name: wait_timeout
variables.label: Idle connection timeout
variables.description: Seconds an inactive non-interactive connection may remain open.

variables.name: net_read_timeout
variables.label: Network read timeout
variables.description: Seconds MariaDB waits for more data from a connected client.

variables.name: net_write_timeout
variables.label: Network write timeout
variables.description: Seconds MariaDB waits while sending a block to a connected client.

variables.name: max_connections
variables.label: Maximum connections
variables.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

variables.name: extra_max_connections
variables.label: Emergency connections
variables.description: Connections reserved for administrative access when the main limit is full.

variables.name: max_user_connections
variables.label: Connections per user
variables.description: Global default ceiling for simultaneous connections from one database user.

variables.name: net_buffer_length
variables.label: Initial network buffer
variables.description: Starting per-connection network buffer size.

variables.name: max_allowed_packet
variables.label: Maximum packet size
variables.description: Largest packet accepted by MariaDB clients and the server.

variables.name: extra_port
variables.label: Emergency connection port
variables.description: Separate port used for administrative connections.

variables.name: innodb_lock_wait_timeout
variables.label: InnoDB lock wait timeout
variables.description: Seconds a statement waits for an InnoDB row lock before failing.

variables.name: innodb_old_blocks_pct
variables.label: InnoDB old buffer percentage
variables.description: Percentage of the Buffer Pool LRU reserved for older pages.

variables.name: innodb_old_blocks_time
variables.label: InnoDB old block delay
variables.description: Delay before an old Buffer Pool page can move to the new sublist.

variables.name: innodb_stats_persistent_sample_pages
variables.label: Persistent statistics sample pages
variables.description: Index pages sampled when MariaDB calculates persistent optimizer statistics.

variables.name: innodb_print_all_deadlocks
variables.label: Log all InnoDB deadlocks
variables.description: Write every InnoDB deadlock report to the MariaDB error log.

variables.name: innodb_status_output_locks
variables.label: InnoDB lock status output
variables.description: Include extended lock details in periodic InnoDB status output.

variables.name: innodb_strict_mode
variables.label: InnoDB strict mode
variables.description: Reject invalid or incompatible InnoDB table options instead of warning.

variables.name: innodb_buffer_pool_size
variables.label: InnoDB Buffer Pool size
variables.description: Memory reserved for caching InnoDB data and indexes.

variables.name: innodb_buffer_pool_size_max
variables.label: InnoDB Buffer Pool live ceiling
variables.description: MariaDB 11.8 ceiling for increasing the Buffer Pool without a restart.

variables.name: innodb_buffer_pool_size_auto_min
variables.label: InnoDB Buffer Pool automatic minimum
variables.description: MariaDB 11.8 lower boundary for automatic Buffer Pool resizing.

variables.name: innodb_log_file_size
variables.label: InnoDB redo log size
variables.description: Size of the InnoDB redo log used for crash recovery.

variables.name: innodb_force_recovery
variables.label: InnoDB force recovery mode
variables.description: Emergency recovery level used when normal InnoDB startup cannot complete.

variables.name: innodb_snapshot_isolation
variables.label: InnoDB snapshot isolation
variables.description: Controls write conflict detection for repeatable-read transactions.

variables.name: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit
variables.label: Flush log at transaction commit
variables.description: Controls transaction durability when MariaDB or the host crashes.

variables.name: tmp_table_size
variables.label: In-memory temporary table size
variables.description: Per-connection ceiling before internal temporary tables move to disk.

variables.name: max_heap_table_size
variables.label: MEMORY table size
variables.description: Maximum size of user-created MEMORY tables and one temporary-table limit.

variables.name: tmp_disk_table_size
variables.label: Temporary disk table size
variables.description: Size limit used for internal temporary tables stored on disk.

variables.name: key_buffer_size
variables.label: MyISAM key buffer size
variables.description: Memory reserved for MyISAM index blocks.

variables.name: tmpdir
variables.label: Temporary file directory
variables.description: Directory MariaDB uses for server-side temporary files.

variables.name: max_statement_time
variables.label: Maximum statement time
variables.description: Global time limit after which MariaDB aborts a statement.

variables.name: long_query_time
variables.label: Slow query threshold
variables.description: Execution time after which a query is counted as slow.

variables.name: binlog_expire_logs_seconds
variables.label: Binary log retention
variables.description: Seconds before binary logs are purged automatically. 0 keeps them until purged manually.

variables.name: max_binlog_total_size
variables.label: Binary log size limit
variables.description: Disk space all binary logs may use before the oldest are purged. 0 means no limit.

variables.name: expire_logs_days
variables.label: Legacy binary log retention
variables.description: Legacy day-based retention period for binary logs.

variables.name: log_bin
variables.label: Binary logging
variables.description: Whether MariaDB writes binary logs for recovery and replication.

variables.name: binlog_format
variables.label: Binary log format
variables.description: How data changes are represented in the binary log.

variables.name: log_slave_updates
variables.label: Log replica updates
variables.description: Whether updates received from a primary are written to this server's binary log.

variables.name: slave_connections_needed_for_purge
variables.label: Replica connections needed for purge
variables.description: MariaDB 11.8 replica-connection threshold used before old row versions are purged.

variables.name: read_only
variables.label: Read-only mode
variables.description: Prevents ordinary database users from changing non-temporary tables.

variables.name: local_infile
variables.label: Local file imports
variables.description: Allows clients to upload local files through LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE.

variables.name: myisam_recover_options
variables.label: MyISAM recovery options
variables.description: Recovery behavior used when MariaDB opens a damaged MyISAM table.

variables.name: performance_schema

variables.description: Collects instrumentation used by database performance diagnostics.

variables.name: performance_schema_instrument
variables.label: Performance Schema instruments

variables.name: performance_schema_consumer_events_statements_history_long

variables.name: performance_schema_consumer_events_stages_current

variables.name: performance_schema_consumer_events_stages_history
variables.label: Stage event history
variables.description: Collect short execution-stage instrumentation history.

variables.name: performance_schema_consumer_events_stages_history_long
variables.label: Long stage event history
variables.description: Collect long execution-stage instrumentation history.

variables.name: performance_schema_consumer_events_waits_current

variables.description: Collect current wait instrumentation events.
